about: The falsifier: verify published with two lines obligations leads. obligations/pipeline/verify/command and obligations/pipeline/verify/key name no need; verify's lock took them because verify is the third step of their scope.

Refusing every line another place leads fails from the other side, and so does letting only the families the wire lists name a place: a place is then published without the lines whose needs are its own code.

cases.name: verify published with obligations' two heads
every line another place leads refused, needs or not
a later step names a place only after a family the wire lists
